description: This PHP source file defines the TimeModuleController class within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. The class extends an abstract controller and provides a handle method that redirects to the default path for the time module.

classes.name: TimeModuleController
classes.description: Controller class for handling time module related requests, primarily redirecting to the default time module page.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the request by obtaining the default path for the time module and redirecting the user to that path.
